scripts.dev:local: pnpm db:start && pnpm --parallel --filter auth --filter app dev
scripts.db:types:local: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN=local pnpm dlx supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > packages/supabase/src/database.types.ts
